source_review_fixes.finding: Overlay layout showed an expansion button whose state was immediately cancelled.
source_review_fixes.resolution: Expansion button is hidden for every data-overlay=true layout.

source_review_fixes.finding: Opening overlay chat could leave keyboard focus in the inert work area.
source_review_fixes.resolution: Opening overlay focuses chat composer and sets work/sidebar inert; dialog semantics added.

source_review_fixes.finding: Returning to a remembered local tab reset the chat reference label to the default tab.
